prefs.notes: Every global setting (the native core reads it through JNI from the app's in-memory SharedPreferences: AndroidSettingsInterface). Keys are 'Section/Key' exactly as in desktop DuckStation's settings.ini. Keep each key's XML element type: list settings are <string> even when numeric (GPU/ResolutionScale is "5"), switches are <boolean>, spin boxes are <int> or <float>; a wrong type makes the Java preference screen throw ClassCastException or the native read fall back to the default. Read once per process start (SharedPreferences cache); the app rewrites the whole file on every settings change. Root only. Holds controller bindings (Pad1/* string sets) and RetroAchievements switches.

playtime.notes: Play time per serial (binary/text written by the app). Read-only for adapters.

per_game.game_id: Disc serial with dash, e.g. SLUS-00553 (the PS1 boot executable name). For multi-disc sets listed in the game database the file is named after the FIRST disc's serial (Chrono Cross = SLUS-01041 for both discs) unless that file sets [Main] UseSeparateConfigForDiscSet = true. Serials of scanned games are in /data/data/com.github.stenzek.duckstation/cache/gamelist.cache (binary; grep -a for S[CL][UEP][SM]-[0-9]{5}).
per_game.notes: Plain INI ([Section] / Key = value), written by the Java ini4j library on every change in Game Properties and deleted when it becomes empty. Keys are the global prefs keys split at the LAST '/': GPU/ResolutionScale -> [GPU] ResolutionScale = 5. VALUES ARE PLAIN TEXT: strip the JSON quotes the glossary uses for prefs strings (write ResolutionScale = 5, Renderer = Vulkan, WidescreenHack = true). Bools are written true/false. A missing key means 'use global' (the UI's tri-state switches remove the key). Loaded from disk by the native core when a game boots (System::GetGameSettingsInterface), so it can be created by hand; needs Main/ApplyGameSettings true (the default). Only keys marked per_game appear in the Game Properties UI, but the core reads any core key from it.

renderer.label: Settings > Graphics > GPU Renderer
renderer.notes: Stored as <string>. Core default is Automatic (Settings::DEFAULT_GPU_RENDERER); the preference XML lists OpenGL as the UI default. Changing it mid-game takes effect on the next game start. Per-game: [GPU] Renderer = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

resolution_scale.label: Settings > Graphics > Internal Resolution
resolution_scale.notes: Stored as <string>. Multiplier of native PS1 resolution. Hardware renderers only. Per-game: [GPU] ResolutionScale = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

texture_filter.label: Settings > Graphics > Texture Filtering
texture_filter.notes: Stored as <string>. Per-game: [GPU] TextureFilter = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

sprite_texture_filter.label: Settings > Graphics > Sprite Texture Filtering
sprite_texture_filter.notes: Stored as <string>. Filter used for 2D sprites. Per-game: [GPU] SpriteTextureFilter = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

dithering.label: Settings > Graphics > Dithering
dithering.notes: Stored as <string>. Per-game: [GPU] DitheringMode = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

widescreen_hack.label: Settings > Graphics > Widescreen Rendering

values.true: On: widens the 3D field of view to the display aspect ratio

widescreen_hack.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Pair with aspect_ratio 16:9 (or 20:9 for the Thor's panel). The game database disables it for games with the DisableWidescreen trait unless Apply Compatibility Settings is off. Per-game: [GPU] WidescreenHack = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

pgxp.label: Settings > Graphics > PGXP Geometry Correction

values.true: On: reduces wobbly polygons and warping textures

pgxp.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Hardware renderers only. The PGXP sub-options below only act when this is on. Per-game: [GPU] PGXPEnable = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

pgxp_culling.label: Settings > Advanced > PGXP Culling Correction

values.true: On

pgxp_culling.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Per-game: [GPU] PGXPCulling = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

pgxp_texture_correction.label: Settings > Advanced > PGXP Texture Perspective Correction

values.true: On

pgxp_texture_correction.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Per-game: [GPU] PGXPTextureCorrection = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

pgxp_color_correction.label: Settings > Advanced > PGXP Color Perspective Correction

values.true: On

pgxp_color_correction.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Per-game: [GPU] PGXPColorCorrection = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

pgxp_depth_buffer.label: Settings > Graphics > PGXP Depth Buffer

values.true: On: depth testing to reduce Z-fighting (low game compatibility)

pgxp_depth_buffer.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Needs pgxp on. Per-game: [GPU] PGXPDepthBuffer = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

pgxp_cpu.label: Settings > Advanced > PGXP CPU Mode

values.true: On: track vertices through the CPU (very slow; some games need it)

pgxp_cpu.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Games with the ForcePGXPCPUMode trait get it from the game database anyway. Per-game: [GPU] PGXPCPU = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

msaa.label: Settings > Advanced > Multisample Antialiasing
msaa.notes: Stored as <string>. Android-only key: the native layer turns it into GPU/Multisamples (the number) and GPU/PerSampleShading (true for -ssaa). Edit MSAA, not Multisamples. Per-game: [GPU] MSAA = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

aspect_ratio.label: Settings > Graphics > Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.notes: Stored as <string>. Per-game: [Display] AspectRatio = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

crop_mode.label: Settings > Graphics > Crop Mode
crop_mode.notes: Stored as <string>. Per-game: [Display] CropMode = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

scaling.label: Settings > Graphics > Scaling
scaling.notes: Stored as <string>. How the final image is scaled to the screen. Per-game: [Display] Scaling = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

stretch.label: Settings > Graphics > Stretch To Fill

values.true: On: stretch the image to fill the screen

stretch.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Per-game: [Display] Stretch = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

force_4_3_fmv.label: Settings > Graphics > Force 4:3 For FMVs

values.true: On

force_4_3_fmv.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Per-game: [Display] Force4_3For24Bit = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

vsync.label: Settings > System > Vertical Sync (VSync)

values.true: On

vsync.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Per-game: [Display] VSync = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

optimal_frame_pacing.label: Settings > System > Optimal Frame Pacing

values.true: On: present every frame, pin threads to big cores

optimal_frame_pacing.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Android UI default false (the desktop core default is true). Per-game: [Display] OptimalFramePacing = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

skip_duplicate_frames.label: Settings > System > Skip Presenting Duplicate Frames

values.true: On

skip_duplicate_frames.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Per-game: [Display] SkipPresentingDuplicateFrames = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

sync_to_host_refresh.label: Settings > System > Sync To Host Refresh Rate

values.true: On: adjust speed so the console refresh matches the screen

sync_to_host_refresh.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Per-game: [Main] SyncToHostRefreshRate = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

emulation_speed.label: Settings > System > Emulation Speed

values.\"4.\": 400% (the app's own value is '4.' with a trailing dot)

emulation_speed.notes: Stored as <string>. Float stored as a string. Any decimal string parses; the UI shows only these. Per-game: [Main] EmulationSpeed = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

fast_forward_speed.label: Settings > System > Fast Forward Speed

values.\"4.\": 400% (the app's own value is '4.' with a trailing dot)

fast_forward_speed.notes: Stored as <string>. Per-game: [Main] FastForwardSpeed = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

runahead.label: Settings > System > Runahead
runahead.notes: Stored as <string>. Global only in the Android UI (not in the per-game screens).

cpu_overclock.label: Settings > System > CPU Overclocking (Can Break Games)
cpu_overclock.notes: Stored as <string>. Android-only key: the native layer converts the percentage to CPU/OverclockNumerator and OverclockDenominator and enables overclock when it is not 100 (behaviour of the last open-source Android code; the closed build was not tested). Edit Overclock, not the numerator keys. Per-game: [CPU] Overclock = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

cpu_execution_mode.label: Settings > Advanced > CPU Execution Mode
cpu_execution_mode.notes: Stored as <string>. Per-game: [CPU] ExecutionMode = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

cpu_icache.label: Settings > Advanced > CPU Recompiler ICache

values.true: On (more accurate; fixes games that run too fast)

cpu_icache.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Games with the ForceRecompilerICache trait get it from the game database anyway. Per-game: [CPU] RecompilerICache = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

cdrom_read_speedup.label: Settings > System > CD-ROM Read Speedup
cdrom_read_speedup.notes: Stored as <string>. Shorter loading; can break some games. Per-game: [CDROM] ReadSpeedup = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

fast_boot.label: Settings > System > Fast Boot

values.true: On: skip the BIOS boot animation

fast_boot.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Per-game: [BIOS] PatchFastBoot = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

audio_backend.label: Settings > Audio > Audio Backend
audio_backend.notes: Stored as <string>. Per-game: [Audio] Backend = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

audio_stretch_mode.label: Settings > Audio > Stretch Mode
audio_stretch_mode.notes: Stored as <string>. Per-game: [Audio] StretchMode = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

audio_buffer_ms.label: Settings > Audio > Buffer Size
audio_buffer_ms.notes: Stored as <int>. Milliseconds, 10-1000. Smaller = lower latency, more crackle risk. Per-game: [Audio] BufferMS = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

audio_output_latency_ms.label: Settings > Audio > Output Latency
audio_output_latency_ms.notes: Stored as <int>. Milliseconds, 10-1000. Audio/OutputLatencyMinimal (bool, not in the Android UI) overrides it with the device minimum. Per-game: [Audio] OutputLatencyMS = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

volume.label: Settings > Audio > Volume
volume.notes: Stored as <int>. Percent, 0-100. Per-game: [Audio] OutputVolume = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

show_fps.label: Settings > General > Show FPS

values.true: On

show_fps.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Global only (not in the per-game screens).

values.true: On

post_processing.label: In-game menu > Post-Processing (shader chain on/off)

values.true: Shader chain on

post_processing.notes: Stored as <boolean>. Global only. The chain is PostProcessing/StageCount (int) plus PostProcessing/Stage<N>/ShaderName for N = 1..StageCount.

post_shader_1.label: Post-Processing > Stage 1 shader
post_shader_1.notes: Stored as <string>. Shader names are the path under assets/shaders (GLSL) or shaders/reshade/Shaders (ReShade .fx) without the extension, as PostProcessing::GetAvailableShaderNames builds them. Needs PostProcessing/Enabled true and PostProcessing/StageCount >= 1. Shader options are stored as PostProcessing/Stage1/<OptionName>. GLSL names verified against the device value and APK assets; ReShade names follow the desktop source and were not tested on Android. Global only.

max_queued_frames.label: Settings > Advanced > Maximum Queued Frames
max_queued_frames.notes: Stored as <string>. Lower = less input latency, more stutter risk. Per-game: [GPU] MaxQueuedFrames = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.

apply_game_settings.label: Settings > Advanced > Apply Game Settings

values.true: Per-game ini files are used

apply_game_settings.notes: May be absent from the prefs file (default applies); the app stores it as <boolean>. Global only. Must stay true for any per-game edit to apply.

apply_compatibility_settings.label: Settings > Advanced > Apply Compatibility Settings

values.true: Game database traits may disable enhancements (widescreen, true color...) per game

apply_compatibility_settings.notes: May be absent from the prefs file (default applies); the app stores it as <boolean>. Per-game: [Main] ApplyCompatibilitySettings = <plain value, no JSON quotes> in gamesettings/<serial>.ini.
